description: This file defines a Java class ModelFieldTypeReader, responsible for reading and caching model field type definitions from XML configuration files within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for loading field types, referencing external resources, and retrieving specific field type definitions.

classes.name: ModelFieldTypeReader
classes.description: A class responsible for reading, caching, and providing access to model field type definitions in OFBiz's entity model framework.

methods.name: createFieldTypeCache
methods.description: Parses the XML document element to create and return a cache map of field types.

methods.name: getModelFieldTypeReader
methods.description: Retrieves a singleton instance of ModelFieldTypeReader for the specified helper, loading from external XML if necessary.

methods.name: getModelFieldType
methods.description: Returns the ModelFieldType object associated with the given fieldTypeName from the internal cache.
